title: Context Schema
description: Reply to `fdc3.discoverability.discoverContextSchema` on app channel `fdc3.discoverability`. Carries the JSON Schema for one context type, or an error when no schema is available.

schemaUrl.title: Schema URL
schemaUrl.description: Canonical URI of the schema when known (`$id` or published AppD/CDN location).

schema.title: JSON Schema
schema.description: The JSON Schema document for this context type (draft-07).

error.title: Error
error.description: Present when the schema could not be resolved; `schema` is omitted.

examples.error: No JSON Schema registered for context type demo.portfolioRisk
